parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminal provision, same-sex conduct legal, and no documented police, border, facility or detention targeting of trans visitors. That addresses the heaviest traveler-facing exposures. Against that, acceptance is documented only in one indigenous territory, explicitly not nationally, and national public opinion is strongly hostile to same-sex marriage, a secondary climate signal. There is no working visitor-facing recourse: no anti-discrimination or hate-crime recognition and reforms blocked in 2024, but under rubric rule 1 those resident gaps are not themselves visitor exposure. Border/document handling, facilities and custody are undocumented open questions, not known exposures. This is a thin traveler-axis record extrapolated from no criminalisation and no targeting, placing it a step below documented acceptance-plus-protections at 0.65-0.75, but above jurisdictions with recurring visitor-facing harm.
